statements.proposition: This change updates src/cook-web/next.config.ts to configure images.remotePatterns from an environment variable.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: next.config.ts modified: adds images.remotePatterns built by splitting process.env.PUBLIC_ALLOWED_IMAGE_DOMAINS on commas. The env var actually used is PUBLIC_ALLOWED_IMAGE_DOMAINS, not the NEXT_PUBLIC_ALLOWED_IMAGE_DOMAINS named elsewhere in the PR message; this statement names no variable, so it holds.
